title: Add face subsystem with auto match

context.summary: Add workspace-scoped face identities, face observations, deterministic auto-matching and API management surfaces.
context.background: TASK-38 added the face schema and TASK-44 added image semantic extraction, but no runtime creates or manages face identities yet.

in: Add core face service contracts for listing identities/observations, rename, merge and automatic observation matching.
Extend derived artifact repositories with face list/update/merge operations.
Wire image extraction to create derived face_observation artifacts and face_observations rows when face detection is enabled and the fallback extractor can infer people count.
Match observations to existing workspace identities using same-project face embeddings and a configurable threshold.
Add HTTP API routes for listing face identities, listing observations, renaming identities and merging identities.
Add integration coverage for image upload creating face identities/observations and API rename/merge flows.
Update docs, validators and task ledger.
out: Real cloud/local face detection or recognition model execution.
CLI, MCP or Hermes face commands.

acceptance_criteria: Face identity and observation repository operations are project-scoped.
Enabled image face detection creates face_observation document artifacts and face_observations rows without mutating RAW originals.
Automatic matching reuses an existing workspace identity when embedding similarity meets the threshold and creates a candidate identity otherwise.
GET face identity/observation APIs enforce project authorization and return source-backed records.
PATCH rename and POST merge APIs update identities and reassign observations safely within one project.
Integration tests cover image-derived face observations plus rename and merge APIs.

manual_checks: Confirm face API responses are project-scoped and source-backed.

risks: The MVP face detector is deterministic fallback logic until a real face model adapter is installed.
Embedding matching is implemented in repository/service code and should be replaced by vector-index search for large deployments.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
